text:
Roughly half of Mexican service users reported paying a bribe in the year before the 2017 Global Corruption Barometer, which I recall as about 51%. That is well above the Latin American regional average of about 29%, so the team note that Mexico was near the average is likely wrong. I can't check the source from here, so please confirm against the TI GCB 2017 Latin America report.

CONFIDENCE: 55
